header: Operator details as label and value pairs
text: Two to twelve pairs in a real description list, at two, three or four columns. The short value takes the register number or the identifier; the long text takes the sentence that goes with it.
note: A summary, never a substitute: which details are required depends on the operator, so the link points at the imprint page and this block stays a pointer to it.

rows.title: The title is the term
rows.text: and the text is the sentence under it

rows.title: A pair may have only a value
or only a text
rows.text: Long entries wrap inside their column instead of widening it

rows.title: Identifiers break anywhere
rows.text: A VAT ID has no break opportunity of its own
